name: Presidential Zardari Slate Blue Leather Chappal
subtitle: Master-crafted full-grain matte leather with ornate perimeter bead welting and durable tyre sole
description: An exquisite contemporary interpretation of a storied classic, this chappal showcases the revered Zardari crossover silhouette in a rare and distinguished slate blue hue. Handcrafted by master artisans with precision edge-stitching and an ornate metallic-beaded welt, it effortlessly bridges imperial Pakistani heritage with modern sophistication. An ergonomic memory-padded footbed and rugged tyre-rubber sole ensure commanding posture and enduring comfort from dawn ceremonies to evening soirees.
features: Iconic crossover Zardari-cut vamp with custom heat-embossed artisanal crest
Signature decorative gold-tone bead-welting meticulously inlaid around the broad square toe
Ultra-supple matte-finished premium cowhide engineered for a glovelike fit
Durable vulcanized tyre-tread sole designed for lifelong traction and durability
materials: 100% Full-Grain Cowhide Leather Upper, Solid Brass Adjustment Buckle, Metallic Bead Welt Trim, Cushioned Leather-Lined Insole, Recycled Tyre Rubber Outsole
